|gr1= Broken Commands

|descr= Returns the object around where the unit finds cover. The minDist, visibilityPosition and ignoreObject parameters are optional.
{{Feature|important|Not implemented in {{arma2}} and later titles (always returns [[objNull]]).}}

|s1= object [[findCover]] [position, hidePosition, maxDist, minDist, visibilityPosition, ignoreObject]

|p1= object: [[Object]]

|p2= position: [[Position]]

|p3= hidePosition: [[Position#PositionATL|PositionATL]] - [[getHideFrom]]-like position from which the unit should hide

|p4= maxDist: [[Number]]

|p5= minDist: [[Number]] - (Optional)

|p6= visibilityPosition: [[Position]] - (Optional) used to select cover that unit can see in that direction from

|p7= ignoreObject: [[Object]] - (Optional) ignore this object in visibility check

|r1= [[Object]] - always [[objNull]]

|x1= <sqf>unit1 findCover [ASLToATL aimPos unit2, 30];</sqf>

|seealso= [[getHideFrom]] [[setHideBehind]] [[isHidden]]
}}
